items.headline: Wings star Fudd out for season with knee injury
items.detail: Wings star guard Azzi Fudd, the No. 1 pick in this year's WNBA draft, will undergo a procedure on her injured right knee and miss the remainder of the season.

items.headline: Cunningham: WNBA needs 'bold' commissioner
items.detail: Sophie Cunningham said the WNBA needs a "bold" commissioner "who wants the best for the players and not maybe for themselves."

items.headline: Sabally out of FIBA WC amid concussion recovery
items.detail: New York Liberty forward Satou Sabally, who is still recovering from a concussion, will not play for Germany when the country hosts the FIBA Women's World Cup next month.

items.headline: 🏀 The secrets behind Angel Reese's rebounding
items.detail: Angel Reese isn't the tallest player in the league, and she isn't its best leaper. So how is it that she's grabbing rebounds at a pace never before seen in the WNBA?

items.headline: Power Rankings: NL domination and rising AL wild-card contenders
items.detail: Atlanta jumps Tampa Bay to take the No. 3 spot as the NL continues to dominate the top 10, and the AL wild-card race heats up.

items.headline: Ex-All-Star Cortes agrees to 1-year deal with Phils
items.detail: Former All-Star left-hander Nestor Cortes agreed to a one-year contract with the Philadelphia Phillies, a deal that will pay him $1.5 million while in the major leagues and $250,000 while in the minors.

items.headline: Islanders announce 'Navy Lighthouse' design as winner of fan-voted third jersey contest
items.detail: The New York Islanders put the fate of their third jersey design in the hands of their fans -- and they've landed on a winning concept.

items.headline: Wemby named France captain for FIBA qualifiers
items.detail: The French national team announced Victor Wembanyama as its captain Wednesday in preparation for the FIBA World Cup European qualifiers.

items.headline: Knicks title 'embarrassing' to Nets, owner says
items.detail: Nets owner Joe Tsai admitted in a recent interview that the Knicks' title run is "embarrassing" to his franchise.

items.headline: 👀 Westbrook offered hint ahead of retirement
items.detail: The nine-time All-Star and former MVP announced his retirement on Wednesday after 18 NBA seasons.
